versions.changelog:
- Initial release of 智美人AI实战课（zhi-mei-ren-course）.
- Covers foundational concepts and toolchain setup for AI Agents, including digital instructor videos, practical code, and exercises.
- Includes content on OpenClaw setup, skill installation, MCP tools, multi-Agent collaboration, and real-world application.
- Integrates with supporting skills: course-builder-agent, skill-forge, and vision-pro.
- Targeted at AI beginners, developers, and creators interested in building and monetizing AI Agent skills.
